status: diagnostic source inventory; no new authored Actions, candidate scores or runtime acceptance
interval_semantics: zero-based half-open frame ranges local to each uploaded file
timebase_basis: Every native decoded frame PTS read with ffprobe, exact n*256 at 1/15360, including final packet duration. Existing source-file hashes reused from verified download inventory.
camera_acceptance: Use fixed review camera and visible motion. Hidden geometry is not an acceptance gate. Hidden or off-screen anatomy is unscored.

footage_overlap.exact_pixels: No identical decoded native YUV420P frame in any of 18 U1–U6 versus R1–R3 comparisons. See uploaded/decoded_pixel_overlap.json.
footage_overlap.visual_coverage: Related action families overlap, but sampled scenes show distinct material: downward legs/firing-range views and new street/car/ledge examples. Different weapon/camera takes cannot replace old source frame correspondence.
footage_overlap.limit: Zero exact decoded matches does not rule out re-encoded footage. A full perceptual sequence alignment was not performed; do not label every frame unique.
footage_overlap.split_files: U3 and U4 are separate local timelines. Do not concatenate, add an invented original-video offset, or assume the part seam is an action boundary.
